assets.runtimeCopyReason: Liquid surface renderer caches full textures per fill-row. Bounds floor/ceil spans 11 rows: 128*58*4*11 = 326656 bytes (319 KiB) RGBA32 payload per liquid color; original 144 rows require 905395968 bytes.
